blind.description: A low, rounded mound of stylized dark grey-brown rocks and boulders fused together with vibrant yellow-orange veins running between them and dark green mossy soil filling the crevices. Embedded in one side is a small mining pick or hand tool with a light brown wooden handle and a dark metal head stuck into the rock. The geometry is continuous and solid with stylized hand-painted textures, sitting directly and flatly on the ground plane.
blind.from_above: A circular, bumpy cluster of dark boulders laced with bright yellow-orange veins and green patches, with a small brown tool handle protruding on one edge.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 2 to 2.5 ft tall (roughly knee- to thigh-high on the 5 ft 9 in figure) and roughly 4 to 5 ft across in diameter.

notes: tool stuck in mound appears as a mining pick rather than a shovel
